title: @nuxt/typescript-build is deprecated
summary: npm marks @nuxt/typescript-build as deprecated: "Nuxt 2 has reached EOL and is no longer actively maintained. See https://nuxt.com/blog/nuxt2-eol for more details."

constraints: Preserve TypeScript compilation, type checking, and the build-module behavior the project depends on.

steps.title: Plan the Nuxt 3 upgrade
steps.instructions: Follow the Nuxt 3 migration guidance for build modules and TypeScript configuration before removing the module.

steps.title: Drop the TypeScript build module
steps.instructions: Remove @nuxt/typescript-build from buildModules and the project dependencies; Nuxt 3 compiles and type-checks TypeScript without a build module.

verification.purpose: Build the Nuxt 3 application with its built-in TypeScript support.
Run the application and repository tests when defined.
